description: Erection of a single storey rear and infill extension to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (01 Rev. A, 02 Rev. A, Site Location Plan - received 22nd March 2023) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The ground floor side window shown on the approved plans shall be fitted with obscured glazing and shall be non-opening to a height of 1.7m above the finished floor level of the room in which it is installed. The window shall be maintained as such thereafter.
Reason: To safeguard the amenity of neighbouring occupiers of the site in accordance with Local Plan policies CC1, CC2 and SC7.
